messages:
maya: heads-up: after the heuristic tweak rolled at 08:00 we saw 95th latency jump on small requests. baseline was ~120ms -> now ~340ms across small-microbatch flows. any quick ideas?
owen: saw the alert. shaping looks different: queue depth oscillating, many tiny microbatches landing with kernel fallback. suspect kernel selection path.
sven: I captured a perf dump for a shard: `kv_cache_lock_wait_ms` spikes align with high latency. also kernel_choice log shows `fallback=generic_attention` often for seq_len<=32 which is weird.
li: did the token_budget target change? the new heuristic increased lookahead and token_budget from 256->1024 for short sequences in the roll-out config. that could increase in-flight KV entries per request.
kate: timeline: heuristic v2.4 deployed 08:00, config: `batch_window_ms=8` -> 6, `token_budget_target=1024` for interactive profiles. We ramped to 25% traffic.
maya: perf-bot flamepull?
perf-bot: collected profiles: `profiles/1812345678/trace-08-10.pb`. Top stack: `accept_loop -> form_batch -> prefetch_kv -> acquire_kv_lock -> run_attention_generic` heavy.
owen: the prefetch path is now aggressive, starting reads for many requests before kernel choice resolved. that inflates KV concurrent accesses and holds locks while we pick a non-optimal kernel. leads to contention + poor cache locality.
sven: also noticed kernel selection uses heuristics tuned for median batch sizes. with lots of tiny batches we fall back to `generic_attention` (non-quantized) causing 3x per-token cost. logs: `kernel_select: seq=16 batch=3 hw=nvidia-a100 -> selected=generic_attention cpu_ms=3.4 quantized_ms=1.1`.
li: root cause hypothesis: larger token_budget + smaller window -> more in-flight partial requests -> prefetch grabs KV locks early -> kernel selection falls back (maybe due to sequence-length heuristics) -> holding locks longer -> queuing/backpressure -> latency spike.
kate: can we reproduce in staging? steps to reproduce: 1) set token_budget_target=1024 for interactive profile 2) set batch_window_ms=6 3) send 70 rps of seq<=32 short requests.
maya: reproduced locally with synthetic load. KV lock contention graph: `kv_lock_wait_p90=420ms` under those settings. rollback to token_budget=256 drops p95 to 140ms.
owen: quick mitigation options: - rollback token_budget change - make prefetch non-blocking (defer lock until kernel selected) - make kernel selection conservative when batch_size<4
sven: on kernel side, we can add a fastpath: if seq<=32 && batch<=4 && quant_profile_available -> prefer quantized fused kernel. small change but risky.
li: I pushed a temporary config rollback to 5% canary -> 0% at 08:45. deploy-bot: rollout v2.4 -> v2.3 (canary reduced to 0%) completed at 08:46.
kate: action items: 1) revert token_budget_target default for interactive profiles (done) 2) add prefetch to be lock-free (sven/owen) 3) add conservative kernel choice for microbatches (sven) 4) add regression test for kv_lock_wait under short-seq microbatch workloads (li)
maya: I created a short checklist: `GH-3492` (rollback verified), `GH-3493` (prefetch non-blocking spike), `GH-3494` (microbatch kernel path).
owen: I'll prototype deferring KV lock until after kernel choice this afternoon and post traces.
sven: I'll open a PR for the microbatch kernel-fastpath, will mark as WIP.
li: I'll add a synthetic perf test in the evaluation harness that runs seq<=32 at 80rps and asserts kv_lock_wait_p95<50ms.
kate: good. let's re-run the ramp after all changes. also add a dashboard alert for kv_lock_wait_ms P95.
maya: thanks all. leaving this thread open for traces. if anyone posts new logs prefix with `TRACE-ID` so we can tie to perf-bot artifacts. :thumbsup:
